\[
\operatorname{circleAverage}(f,c)=\int_{\mathbb{R}} f(x-c)\,dx
\]

### Step 2:
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} f(x-c)\,dx=\int_{\mathbb{R}} f(u)\,du
\]

### Step 3:
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} f(u)\,du=\operatorname{integral}(f)
\]

### Step 4:
\[
\operatorname{circleAverage}(f,c)=\operatorname{integral}(f)
\]
